name: path_tags
desc: filter on array membership + projection to object

name: group_agg
note: jsonata-js 2.2.2 is O(n^2): each item is appended to its group with fn.append (a copy); the engine gathers a group in one buffer

name: group_nested
desc: group by owner within each system (nested group)

name: join_scan
desc: join: first 20 relations, lookup by linear filter inside lambda (O(20*N))

name: join_index
desc: join: all relations via an index object built with $merge, $lookup inside lambda

name: sort_fn
desc: $sort with a comparator lambda (cost desc, id asc)
note: jsonata-js 2.2.2 merge sort is O(n^2) in time and memory (slice(1) recursion); JS OOMs at 50k

name: regex
desc: regex: $contains with regex, $replace with regex + backreference, $match

name: recursion_tree
desc: recursive walk over the whole document (counts objects), non-tail recursion depth ~7

name: tail_loop
desc: tail-recursive loop, iterations = number of components

name: fib
desc: non-tail recursion fib(18), data-independent (only run at smallest size)

name: deep_map
desc: non-tail recursion depth 40 inside a map over 20 000 items (condition U1 of the chief architect), data-independent
